heading: The Ukraine Crisis: Which countries are accepting refugees within the transatlantic community?
content:
Since Russia's invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, over 7.5 million refugees have fled Ukraine's borders.

In this infographic, we take a look at which countries featured in the [Transatlantic Barometer](https://www.transatlanticbarometer.org/humanitarian-aid-to-ukraine-and-refugee-intake) are accepting refugees. For more information, visit the [Transatlantic Barometer](https://www.transatlanticbarometer.org/humanitarian-aid-to-ukraine-and-refugee-intake).

Source: UNHCR, the UN Refugee Agency
